name: Spotify MCP
description: Enables remote interaction with Spotify through the Model Context Protocol, allowing users to search tracks, control playback, and manage playlists with per-user OAuth authentication. It is hosted on Cloudflare Workers and supports remote MCP over HTTP for compatible clients.
